messages:
Ava (PM): quick sync — i'm drafting a launch decision tree for the new tenant-prefetch/caching initiative. want to capture hard blockers + minimum gate criteria. can everyone call out the one blocker that would stop your team from signing off?
Ravi (Eng): question — do we have agreed launch tiers? like A = internal, B = beta customers, C = GA. that changes scale expectations.
Ava (PM): yes — good call. thinking A/internal, B/early customers (~5-10 tenants), C/GA. decision tree should route to fallback model or throttle policy based on tier and latency SLA.
Lina (Runtime): runtime blocker = no KV-cache migration path for tenants on older model variants. if we can't do prefix/KV caching transparently, latency bump could fail the SLA for B.
Marc (Infra): infra blocker = prewarm slots + reserved GPUs not locked in yet. need confirmed capacity reservation for B window or we risk cold starts. also KMS/HSM key rotation plan for Private pilots.
Sam (Security): security blocker = audit log and tenant isolation validation. for B we need proof logs are available to customer ops and internal audit. also threat-model doc for prefetching.
Omar (SRE): SRE blocker = no rollback/rollback-test plan. we need a canary weight plan and automated circuit breaker that drops to fallback model on >5% error or p95 token latency >450ms.
Ravi (Eng): can we codify the decision tree nodes? e.g.
```
if tier == A: allow feature flag rollout to team
elif tier == B and capacity_reserved and kv_compat: enable prefetch
else: enable prefetch-limited or keep on-demand
```
Ava (PM): exactly — that sample logic is what i'm after. Lina/Marc, can you confirm kv_compat and capacity_reserved boolean owners and acceptance tests?
Lina (Runtime): owner for kv_compat = runtime team. acceptance test = end-to-end perf run with representative prompt-set (seeded) hitting cached vs uncached. target: p95 within 1.2x baseline.
Marc (Infra): owner for capacity_reserved = infra. acceptance test = prewarm harness that simulates burst shape (90th percentile traffic) for 30m. need signoff by infra eng and finance for reservations.
Sam (Security): for audit logs: owner = security. acceptance test = customer audit export script + internal tamper-proofing verification. timeline: need this before B; can't accept B without it.
Omar (SRE): rollback criteria i can own. propose: canary 5% -> 25% -> 50% -> 100% over 24h with automatic health checks. if any health check fails twice in 15m, auto-fallback to previous model variant.
Ravi (Eng): two asks from eng: 1) a stable model-variant pinning scheme for the canary to avoid noisy commits during rollout; 2) an API-level toggle (feature flag) to disable prefetch per-tenant.
Ava (PM): i'll add those as nodes in the tree. also thinking of a "blocker matrix" in the doc mapping owner -> blocker -> must-meet-before-B. good?
Lina (Runtime): yes. also note: runtime needs a small migration window to backfill KV for existing tenants. that affects scheduling — call it a 48-72h window.
Marc (Infra): infra calendar note: if prewarm reservations cross billing periods, finance needs heads up. i'll add the cost estimate to the matrix.
Sam (Security): adding one more: data residency for Private customers. if the pilot includes private deploys, we need KMS attestation & network policy checklist before B.
Ava (PM): great. i'll assemble the decision tree + blocker matrix doc and post a link. can everyone drop a one-line owner confirmation below (owner name + "ok") so i can finalize owners quickly?
Ravi (Eng): Ravi (Eng): ok
Lina (Runtime): Lina (Runtime): ok (will attach perf test plan)
Marc (Infra): Marc (Infra): ok (will add reservation estimate)
Sam (Security): Sam (Security): ok (will add audit checklist & residency notes)
Omar (SRE): Omar (SRE): ok (will draft canary + rollback runbook)
deploy-bot: deploy-bot: reminder — create a private doc in #docs-launches with the decision tree link when ready :robot_face:
Ava (PM): thanks all — aiming to post doc EOD PST. if anyone thinks this is missing a critical node, ping me directly. :sparkles:
